title: Six Months for Gasoline, One Month for Diesel
subtitle: The length of each export ban is a statement about which fuel the government expects to stay scarce.

source.name: Russian government decisions on fuel export restrictions

data.label: Gasoline export ban
data.annotation: A half-year restriction points to a structural shortfall, not a seasonal one.

supportingFacts.label: The 100,000-ton contract with Kyrgyzstan was written against exchange quotations rather than fixed terms.
Strikes have concentrated damage on the units that make motor gasoline rather than on distillate capacity.

metadata.keyFinding: The gasoline export ban was extended six times longer than the diesel ban.
